sources.title: Acoustic characteristics of American English vowels
sources.notes: Use only recovered numeric values with population labels. Formant Canvas already has an audited adult male/female diphthong trajectory integration on a feature branch. Child data must not be mixed with younger Lee-style presets because Hillenbrand children are a different age cohort.

sources.title: Hara (2016) Japanese vowel / vowel-sequence acoustic data
sources.notes: Published tables provide contextual F1/F2 targets and timing/transition summaries. They do not provide a sequence-specific normalized-time measured trajectory. Suitable for labeled endpoint/context evidence, not for claiming empirical continuous VV motion.

sources.title: Acoustic, Auditory and Articulatory Analysis of Vowel Sequences in Japanese by Chinese Learners
sources.notes: Includes native Japanese speakers and ultrasound articulatory analysis. The public article describes 20 formant measurement points, but a reusable native-speaker group numeric trajectory series has not yet been recovered. Reference/evidence only until numeric provenance is available.

sources.title: Pink Trombone
sources.author: Neil Thapen
sources.notes: Candidate tract-synthesis backend/reference. Keep third-party-derived code isolated and preserve copyright/license notices.

sources.title: VocalTractLab

sources.notes: Reference for articulatory parameterization and vocal-tract modeling. Do not copy GPL source into a differently licensed codebase without intentionally accepting the license implications.

sources.title: Sounds of Speech
sources.notes: Reference for educational presentation of articulatory information. Treat visual/media assets according to their own rights; do not copy them into the app without permission/license review.
